bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress for commuter safety.
The Home Secretary transferred four police officers, including Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran, and the office should watch for further administrative changes.
Police arrested two people after thirty-one sovereigns of gold jewelry were stolen from a teacher's house in Redhills, and the office should monitor local security measures.
Heavy traffic congestion occurred on Poonamallee Mount Road during Diwali, and the office should coordinate with traffic authorities to improve management during festivals.
Passengers at Avadi railway station flagged delays in reconstructing platform four, and the office should follow up with railway officials to expedite the sanctioned work.
Vultr launched a twenty-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over ten thousand AMD GPUs, and the office should promote local tech infrastructure growth.
The University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should support academic and industry digital partnerships.
Telangana targeted one hundred new Global Capability Centres for Hyderabad, and the office should watch regional competitiveness in attracting high-value technology investments.
